name: White 24
notes: Thin grey wing lines over the shoulder and sleeve, plus a red hem band. Not a single stripe.
how: from/to are fractions of the sleeve length L, measured along the sleeve from the hem edge; L = hem to the top of the shoulder cap along the outer sleeve line in the art (same template for every jersey). mm uses the 3D jersey: hem to shoulder top = 0.168 m.
